renderContract.commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium work-motivation close-emotion guardian card master artwork, full-bleed 3:4. Show exactly the named single guardian or canonical internal pair from the approved source; never add a coworker, client, recipient, extra guardian, human, body clue, reflection, silhouette, empty seat or personal belonging implying another person. Preserve canonical identity, relative size/colors, clothing, signature props, dark-purple eyes with exactly one large plus one small highlight in each visible eye, and visible chest Stella stars. Guardian or canonical pair plus the focal work device covers 55–65% and remains readable at actual width 80px. Frame face, hands/fins and the first work control closely so motivation, anticipation and burden can coexist; never show guaranteed success, completed productivity, promotion, applause or predetermined outcome. Written work surfaces use symbols and isolated geometric reliefs only: no readable text, pseudo-text, handwriting lines, names, labels, score, number, clock, calendar grid, map coordinate, question mark, zodiac glyph, arrow route, logo or watermark. Do not bake actual birth-chart lines or personal colors into the master art. Every knob, flag token, box, tile, peg, clip, gate, lock, marker, machine stop or tag remains removable, half-set, unlatched, blank or not yet applied. Keep every composition distinct in close camera height, hand action, dominant silhouette and open negative-space shape. Only Scorpio canonical tail-heart tip is allowed; no added heart or heart-shaped light/void. No closed ring, halo, portal, infinity sign or deterministic route. Follow compositionFamily, artDirection, distinctFrom and visualReviewFocus literally. Soft colored-pencil and watercolor, visible paper grain, rounded plush proportions and deep-purple outlines; no readable text, no logo, no watermark.
